cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：给；给予
cards.example_en: Please give me that red pen.

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：去；前往
cards.example_en: We go to the library on Sundays.
Tomatoes grow well in our sunny backyard.
cards.example_zh: 西红柿在我们家向阳的后院长得很好。

cards.example_en: The monitor can handle problems while the teacher is out.
cards.example_zh: 老师不在时，班长能处理出现的问题。

cards.example_en: Accidents often happen when people run on wet stairs.
cards.example_zh: 人们在湿楼梯上奔跑时，常常会发生事故。

cards.example_en: I can hear birds singing outside my bedroom window.
cards.example_zh: 我能听见鸟儿在我卧室的窗外唱歌。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：高亮标出
cards.example_en: Highlight the key dates on your revision sheet.
cards.example_zh: 在复习提纲上把重要的日期标出来。

cards.example_en: A fast ball can hit the window beside the gym.
cards.example_zh: 飞快的球可能会打到体育馆旁边的窗户。

cards.example_en: Hold the rope tightly while you cross the stream.
cards.example_zh: 过小溪的时候要紧紧抓住绳子。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：说明；配插图
cards.example_en: Let me illustrate my point with an example.
cards.example_zh: 让我用一个例子来说明我的观点。

cards.example_en: Imagine a quiet beach during the summer holiday.
cards.example_zh: 想象一下暑假里那片安静的海滩。

cards.example_en: Reading every day can improve your English.
cards.example_zh: 每天阅读可以提高你的英语水平。

cards.example_en: The ticket price will include lunch and the bus fare.
cards.example_zh: 票价里将包括午餐和车费。

cards.example_en: Dad will install a brighter lamp in my bedroom.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸会在我的卧室里装一盏更亮的灯。
